# bitbucket-datacenter-api-client — full reference

> TypeScript client for the Bitbucket Data Center REST API v10.3 (`/rest/api/latest`). Isomorphic (Node.js + browser), fully typed, zero runtime dependencies. This file inlines the full API reference in one place; see README.md and ROADMAP.md in the package/repo root for the canonical, most up-to-date versions.

## Install

```bash
npm install bitbucket-datacenter-api-client
```

## Quick start

```typescript
import { BitbucketClient } from 'bitbucket-datacenter-api-client';

const bb = new BitbucketClient({
  apiUrl:  'https://bitbucket.example.com',
  apiPath: 'rest/api/latest',
  user:    'your-username',
  token:   'your-personal-access-token',
});

const projects = await bb.projects({ limit: 50 });
const project  = await bb.project('PROJ');
const repos    = await bb.project('PROJ').repos({ name: 'api' });
const repo     = await bb.project('PROJ').repo('my-repo');
const prs      = await bb.project('PROJ').repo('my-repo').pullRequests({ state: 'OPEN' });
```

## Authentication

Two schemes, selected via `authType` (default `'basic'`):

```typescript
// Basic — username + Personal Access Token or password. `user` is required.
const bb = new BitbucketClient({
  apiUrl: 'https://bitbucket.example.com', apiPath: 'rest/api/latest',
  user: 'your-username', token: 'your-personal-access-token',
});

// Bearer — HTTP access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. No `user` needed.
const bb = new BitbucketClient({
  apiUrl: 'https://bitbucket.example.com', apiPath: 'rest/api/latest',
  token: 'your-http-access-token', authType: 'bearer',
});
```

## Chainable resource pattern

Every resource mapping to a single entity (`ProjectResource`, `RepositoryResource`, `PullRequestResource`, `CommitResource`, `UserResource`) implements `PromiseLike<T>`:

```typescript
const project = await bb.project('PROJ');                    // await directly → fetches the entity
const repos   = await bb.project('PROJ').repos({ limit: 10 }); // chain → fetches a list / sub-resource
const diff    = await bb.project('PROJ').repo('my-repo').commit('abc123').diff();
```

## Method reference

All endpoints below are relative to `/rest/api/latest` unless a full path is shown. Methods marked `⚠️` hit a well-known but *unofficial* endpoint (no documented equivalent exists) and may break between Bitbucket versions.

### BitbucketClient (entry point)

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `projects(params?)` | `GET /projects` |
| `project(key)` | chainable → `ProjectResource` |
| `createProject(data)` | `POST /projects` — `data: { key, name, description?, avatar? }` (avatar as a base64 data URI) |
| `repos(params?)` | `GET /repos` (documented params 1:1: `name`, `projectkey`, `projectname`, `permission`, `visibility`, `state`, `archived`) |
| `search(params?)` | `GET /repos` (legacy variant, prefixes `%` to `name` for a contains-match) |
| `users(params?)` | `GET /users` |
| `user(slug)` | chainable → `UserResource` |
| `currentUser()` | `X-AUSERNAME` response header + `GET /users?filter={name}` (two requests; no official whoami endpoint) |
| `groups(params?)` | `GET /groups` — returns a page of group *names* (plain strings) |
| `dashboardPullRequests(params?)` | `GET /dashboard/pull-requests` — PRs where the authenticated user participates (author, reviewer, etc.) across all repos |
| `inboxPullRequests(params?)` | `GET /inbox/pull-requests` — PRs requiring the authenticated user's attention |
| `inboxPullRequestsCount(params?)` | `GET /inbox/pull-requests/count` |
| `pullRequestSuggestions(params?)` | `GET /dashboard/pull-request-suggestions` — suggestions from the user's recent pushes; params are `changesSince?` (seconds since epoch, default last 48h) and `limit?` only (no `start` offset) |
| `markupPreview(markup, params?)` | `POST /markup/preview` — renders markup (e.g. Markdown) to `{ html }`; the markup goes as the raw request body; `urlMode?`/`htmlEscape?`/`includeHeadingId?`/`hardwrap?` as query params |
| `codeSearch(query, params?)` | `POST /rest/search/latest/search` — global code search with Bitbucket's query syntax (e.g. `'jwt project:PROJ ext:ts'`); hits under `result.code.values`; response typed defensively (`CodeSearchResult`) |

### ProjectResource — `bb.project(key)`

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `get()` | `GET /projects/{key}` |
| `update(data)` | `PUT /projects/{key}` — only `avatar?`, `avatarUrl?`, `key?`, `links?` are writable; `name`/`public`/`type` are read-only on this endpoint |
| `delete()` | `DELETE /projects/{key}` |
| `repos(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos` |
| `repo(slug)` | chainable → `RepositoryResource` |
| `createRepo(data)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos` — `data: { name, scmId?, defaultBranch?, ... }` |
| `users(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/permissions/users` |
| `setUserPermission(name, permission)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/permissions/users?name={name}&permission={permission}` — query params, no body; `permission` is one of `'PROJECT_READ'`/`'PROJECT_WRITE'`/`'PROJECT_ADMIN'` |
| `removeUserPermission(name)` | `DELETE /projects/{key}/permissions/users?name={name}` |
| `groups(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/permissions/groups` |
| `setGroupPermission(name, permission)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/permissions/groups?name={name}&permission={permission}` — same query-param convention as `setUserPermission` |
| `removeGroupPermission(name)` | `DELETE /projects/{key}/permissions/groups?name={name}` |
| `webhooks(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/webhooks` |
| `createWebhook(data)` | `POST /projects/{key}/webhooks` — `data: { name, events, url, active?, sslVerificationRequired?, configuration?, credentials? }` |
| `updateWebhook(webhookId, data)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/webhooks/{webhookId}` — same payload shape as `createWebhook` |
| `deleteWebhook(webhookId)` | `DELETE /projects/{key}/webhooks/{webhookId}` |
| `testWebhook(params)` | `POST /projects/{key}/webhooks/test` — `webhookId?`/`url?`/`sslVerificationRequired?` sent as query params, `username?`/`password?` as the body |
| `searchPermissions(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/permissions/search` — `permission?` (one or many), `filterText?`, `type?` (`'USER'`/`'GROUP'`); entries typed defensively (`PermittedEntity`) |
| `defaultReviewerConditions()` | `GET /rest/default-reviewers/latest/projects/{key}/conditions` |
| `createDefaultReviewerCondition(data)` / `updateDefaultReviewerCondition(id, data)` / `deleteDefaultReviewerCondition(id)` | `POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/default-reviewers/latest/projects/{key}/condition[/{id}]` |
| `branchRestrictions(params?)` / `branchRestriction(id)` | `GET /rest/branch-permissions/latest/projects/{key}/restrictions[/{id}]` |
| `createBranchRestriction(data)` / `deleteBranchRestriction(id)` | `POST/DELETE /rest/branch-permissions/latest/projects/{key}/restrictions[/{id}]` — single restriction as `application/json` (the bulk media type is not wrapped) |
| `reviewerGroups()` / `reviewerGroup(id)` / `createReviewerGroup(data)` / `updateReviewerGroup(id, data)` / `deleteReviewerGroup(id)` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/settings/reviewer-groups[/{id}]` |
| `autoDeclineSettings()` / `updateAutoDeclineSettings(data)` / `deleteAutoDeclineSettings()` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/settings/auto-decline` |
| `autoMergeSettings()` / `updateAutoMergeSettings(data)` / `deleteAutoMergeSettings()` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/settings/auto-merge` |
| `hooks(params?)` / `hook(hookKey)` | `GET /projects/{key}/settings/hooks[/{hookKey}]` |
| `enableHook(hookKey)` / `disableHook(hookKey)` | `PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/settings/hooks/{hookKey}/enabled` |
| `hookSettings(hookKey)` / `updateHookSettings(hookKey, settings)` | `GET/PUT /projects/{key}/settings/hooks/{hookKey}/settings` |
| `defaultTasks(params?)` / `createDefaultTask(data)` / `updateDefaultTask(taskId, data)` / `deleteDefaultTask(taskId)` / `deleteAllDefaultTasks()` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/default-tasks/latest/projects/{key}/tasks[/{taskId}]` |

### RepositoryResource — `bb.project(key).repo(slug)`

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `get()` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}` |
| `update(data)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}` — `data`: any of `name?`, `description?`, `forkable?`, `public?`, `project?: { key }` (moves the repo) |
| `delete()` | `DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}` |
| `fork(data?)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}` — `data?`: `name?`, `project?: { key }`, `defaultBranch?`; omit to fork as-is |
| `forks(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/forks` |
| `pullRequests(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/pull-requests` |
| `pullRequest(id)` | chainable → `PullRequestResource` |
| `createPullRequest(data)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/pull-requests` — `data: { title, fromRef, toRef, description?, reviewers? }` |
| `commits(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/commits` |
| `commit(commitId)` | chainable → `CommitResource` |
| `branches(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/branches` |
| `defaultBranch()` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/branches/default` |
| `setDefaultBranch(branch)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/default-branch` — `branch: { id }` (full ref, e.g. `'refs/heads/main'`); the `branches/default` GET variant stays read-only, this is the write path |
| `createBranch(data)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/branches` — `data: { name, startPoint, message? }` |
| `deleteBranch(data)` | `DELETE /rest/branch-utils/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/branches` — `data: { name, dryRun? }` |
| `tags(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/tags` |
| `tagsByCommits(commits, opts?)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/tags` |
| `createTag(data)` | `POST /rest/git/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/tags` — `data: { name, startPoint, message? }` (annotated tag if `message` set) |
| `deleteTag(tagName)` | `DELETE /rest/git/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/tags/{name}` |
| `lastModified(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/last-modified` |
| `size()` ⚠️ | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/sizes` (unofficial UI endpoint) |
| `raw(filePath, params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/raw/{path}` → plain text |
| `browse(srcPath?, params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/browse/{srcPath}` |
| `editFile(filePath, payload)` | `PUT /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/browse/{path}` (form-encoded) |
| `files(path?, params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/files[/{path}]` — recursive listing, returns a page of path strings |
| `archive(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/archive` → `ArrayBuffer` — `at?`, `format?` (`'zip'` default, `'tar'`, `'tar.gz'`, `'tgz'`), `filename?`, `path?` (one or many), `prefix?` |
| `compareChanges(params?)` / `compareCommits(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/compare/{changes,commits}` — `from`, `to`, `fromRepo?` (cross-fork) |
| `compareDiff(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/compare/diff[/{path}]` (`path` optional) |
| `labels()` / `addLabel(name)` / `removeLabel(name)` | `GET/POST/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/labels[/{labelName}]` |
| `readme(params?)` / `license(params?)` / `contributing(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/{readme,license,contributing}` — response typed defensively (`BitbucketMarkupFile`) |
| `watch()` / `unwatch()` | `POST/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/watch` |
| `refChangeActivities(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/ref-change-activities` — push/branch/tag activity log, filterable by `ref?` |
| `webhooks(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/webhooks/search` |
| `createWebhook(data)` / `updateWebhook(webhookId, data)` / `deleteWebhook(webhookId)` | `POST/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/webhooks[/{webhookId}]` — same payload shape as the project-level variants |
| `testWebhook(params)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/webhooks/test` — `webhookId?`/`url?`/`sslVerificationRequired?` as query params, `username?`/`password?` as the body |
| `settings()` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/pull-requests` |
| `updateSettings(data)` | `POST /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/pull-requests` — partial `BitbucketRepositorySettings`-shaped payload |
| `users(params?)` / `setUserPermission(name, permission)` / `removeUserPermission(name)` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/permissions/users` — `permission` is `'REPO_READ'`/`'REPO_WRITE'`/`'REPO_ADMIN'`, sent as query params |
| `groups(params?)` / `setGroupPermission(name, permission)` / `removeGroupPermission(name)` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/permissions/groups` — same conventions |
| `searchPermissions(params?)` | `GET /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/permissions/search` — `permission?` (one or many), `filterText?`, `type?`; entries typed defensively (`PermittedEntity`) |
| `branchRestrictions(params?)` / `branchRestriction(id)` / `createBranchRestriction(data)` / `deleteBranchRestriction(id)` | `GET/POST/DELETE /rest/branch-permissions/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/restrictions[/{id}]` |
| `defaultReviewerConditions()` / `createDefaultReviewerCondition(data)` / `updateDefaultReviewerCondition(id, data)` / `deleteDefaultReviewerCondition(id)` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/default-reviewers/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/condition[s][/{id}]` |
| `requiredBuildConditions(params?)` / `createRequiredBuildCondition(data)` / `updateRequiredBuildCondition(id, data)` / `deleteRequiredBuildCondition(id)` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/required-builds/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/condition[s][/{id}]` |
| `reviewerGroups()` / `reviewerGroup(id)` / `reviewerGroupUsers(id)` / `createReviewerGroup(data)` / `updateReviewerGroup(id, data)` / `deleteReviewerGroup(id)` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/reviewer-groups[/{id}][/users]` |
| `autoDeclineSettings()` / `updateAutoDeclineSettings(data)` / `deleteAutoDeclineSettings()` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/auto-decline` |
| `autoMergeSettings()` / `updateAutoMergeSettings(data)` / `deleteAutoMergeSettings()` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/auto-merge` |
| `hooks(params?)` / `hook(hookKey)` / `enableHook(hookKey)` / `disableHook(hookKey)` / `hookSettings(hookKey)` / `updateHookSettings(hookKey, settings)` | `GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/settings/hooks[/{hookKey}/…]` — same conventions as the project-level variants |
| `defaultTasks(params?)` / `createDefaultTask(data)` / `updateDefaultTask(taskId, data)` / `deleteDefaultTask(taskId)` / `deleteAllDefaultTasks()` | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rest/default-tasks/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}/tasks[/{taskId}]` |
| `syncStatus(at?)` / `setSyncStatus(data)` / `synchronize(data)` | `GET/POST /rest/sync/latest/projects/{key}/repos/{slug}[/synchronize]` — fork synchronization |

### PullRequestResource — `bb.project(key).repo(slug).pullRequest(id)`

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `get()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}` |
| `update(data)` | `PUT …/pull-requests/{id}` — `data: { version, title?, description?, toRef?, reviewers? }` |
| `delete(data)` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}` — `data: { version }` |
| `merge(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/merge?version={version}` — `data: { version, message?, strategyId?, autoSubject? }` |
| `canMerge()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/merge` → `{ canMerge, conflicted, vetoes[] }` |
| `decline(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/decline?version={version}` |
| `reopen(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/reopen?version={version}` |
| `approve(userSlug)` | `PUT …/pull-requests/{id}/participants/{userSlug}` with `status: 'APPROVED'` |
| `unapprove(userSlug)` | same endpoint, `status: 'UNAPPROVED'` |
| `addReviewer(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/participants` — `data: { user: { name } }` |
| `removeReviewer(userSlug)` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/participants/{userSlug}` |
| `activities(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/activities` |
| `tasks(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/blocker-comments` (tasks are blocker comments since Bitbucket 7.2; legacy `/tasks` was removed in 8.0) |
| `createTask(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/blocker-comments` |
| `updateTask(taskId, data)` | `PUT …/pull-requests/{id}/blocker-comments/{commentId}` |
| `deleteTask(taskId, version)` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/blocker-comments/{commentId}?version={version}` |
| `commits(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/commits` |
| `changes(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/changes` |
| `diff(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/diff/{path}` (`path` optional; `srcPath` selects a previous path for renames) |
| `rawDiff()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}.diff` → plain text |
| `patch()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}.patch` → plain text |
| `diffStatsSummary(path)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/diff-stats-summary/{path}` |
| `comments(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/comments` |
| `addComment(data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/comments` |
| `updateComment(commentId, data)` | `PUT …/pull-requests/{id}/comments/{commentId}` |
| `deleteComment(commentId, version)` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/comments/{commentId}?version={version}` |
| `applySuggestion(commentId, data)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/comments/{commentId}/apply-suggestion` |
| `react(commentId, emoticon)` | `PUT /rest/comment-likes/latest/…/comments/{commentId}/reactions/{emoticon}` |
| `unreact(commentId, emoticon)` | `DELETE` same endpoint |
| `reviewers(params?)` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/participants` |
| `review()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/review` (sparsely documented; response typed defensively) |
| `completeReview(data)` | `PUT …/pull-requests/{id}/review` — `data: { reviewedFiles }` |
| `discardReview()` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/review` |
| `autoMerge()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/auto-merge` (404 if none pending) |
| `requestAutoMerge(data?)` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/auto-merge` |
| `cancelAutoMerge()` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/auto-merge` |
| `watch()` | `POST …/pull-requests/{id}/watch` |
| `unwatch()` | `DELETE …/pull-requests/{id}/watch` |
| `canRebase()` | `GET /rest/git/latest/…/pull-requests/{id}/rebase` |
| `rebase()` | `POST /rest/git/latest/…/pull-requests/{id}/rebase` |
| `mergeBase()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/merge-base` |
| `commitMessageSuggestion()` | `GET …/pull-requests/{id}/commit-message-suggestion` |
| `reports(params?)` | resolves the PR's latest source commit, then `GET /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{commitId}/reports` (two requests; PR-level `/reports` is UI-internal) |
| `buildSummaries()` | fetches PR commits, then `POST /rest/build-status/latest/commits/stats` (two requests; PR-level `/build-summaries` is UI-internal) |
| `issues()` | `GET /rest/jira/latest/…/pull-requests/{id}/issues` |

### CommitResource — `bb.project(key).repo(slug).commit(id)`

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `get()` | `GET …/commits/{id}` |
| `changes(params?)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/changes` |
| `diff(params?)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/diff/{path}` (`path` optional) |
| `diffStatsSummary(path)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/diff-stats-summary/{path}` |
| `comments(params?)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/comments` |
| `addComment(data)` | `POST …/commits/{id}/comments` |
| `updateComment(commentId, data)` | `PUT …/commits/{id}/comments/{commentId}` — `data: { version, text }` |
| `deleteComment(commentId, version)` | `DELETE …/commits/{id}/comments/{commentId}?version={version}` |
| `buildStatuses(params?)` | `GET /rest/build-status/latest/commits/{id}` (legacy) |
| `addBuildStatus(data)` | `POST /rest/build-status/latest/commits/{id}` (legacy) |
| `getBuild(key)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/builds?key={key}` — modern replacement for `buildStatuses`; returns a single build, not a list |
| `addBuild(data)` | `POST …/commits/{id}/builds` — modern replacement for `addBuildStatus` |
| `deleteBuild(key)` | `DELETE …/commits/{id}/builds?key={key}` |
| `getDeployment(params)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/deployments` — `params: { deploymentSequenceNumber, key, environmentKey }` identify a single deployment |
| `addDeployment(data)` | `POST …/commits/{id}/deployments` — creates or updates a deployment |
| `deleteDeployment(params)` | `DELETE …/commits/{id}/deployments` — same lookup params as `getDeployment` |
| `pullRequests(params?)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/pull-requests` — pull requests containing this commit |
| `mergeBase(otherCommitId)` | `GET …/commits/{id}/merge-base/{otherCommitId}` — best common ancestor of the two commits |
| `watch()` | `POST …/commits/{id}/watch` |
| `unwatch()` | `DELETE …/commits/{id}/watch` |
| `insightReports(params?)` / `insightReport(key)` | `GET /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/reports[/{key}]` — Code Insights reports |
| `setInsightReport(key, data)` / `deleteInsightReport(key)` | `PUT/DELETE /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/reports/{key}` |
| `insightAnnotations(params?)` | `GET /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/annotations` — annotations across all reports, filterable |
| `insightReportAnnotations(key)` / `addInsightAnnotations(key, annotations)` | `GET/POST /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/reports/{key}/annotations` |
| `setInsightAnnotation(key, externalId, data)` | `PUT /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/reports/{key}/annotations/{externalId}` |
| `deleteInsightAnnotations(key, externalId?)` | `DELETE /rest/insights/latest/…/commits/{id}/reports/{key}/annotations[?externalId]` — deletes all when `externalId` is omitted |

### UserResource — `bb.user(slug)`

| Method | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `get()` | `GET /users/{slug}` |
| `repos(params?)` | `GET /projects/~{slug}/repos` (personal project convention) |
| `repo(slug)` | chainable → `RepositoryResource`, via `/projects/~{slug}/repos/{repoSlug}` |
| `sshKeys(params?)` | `GET /rest/ssh/latest/keys?user={slug}` |
| `addSshKey(data)` | `POST /rest/ssh/latest/keys?user={slug}` — `data: { text, label?, expiryDays? }`; adding to another user's account requires admin |
| `deleteSshKey(keyId)` | `DELETE /rest/ssh/latest/keys/{keyId}` |
| `settings()` | `GET /users/{slug}/settings` |
| `updateSettings(settings)` | `PUT /users/{slug}/settings` — updates only the entries present in the body |
| `accessTokens(params?)` / `accessToken(tokenId)` | `GET /rest/access-tokens/latest/users/{slug}[/{tokenId}]` — HTTP access tokens (never include the raw secret) |
| `createAccessToken(data)` | `PUT /rest/access-tokens/latest/users/{slug}` — **creates with `PUT`** (Atlassian's verbs); `data: { name, permissions, expiryDays? }`; the response is the only place the raw `token` secret is returned |
| `updateAccessToken(tokenId, data)` | `POST /rest/access-tokens/latest/users/{slug}/{tokenId}` — **updates with `POST`** |
| `deleteAccessToken(tokenId)` | `DELETE /rest/access-tokens/latest/users/{slug}/{tokenId}` |
| `gpgKeys(params?)` | `GET /rest/gpg/latest/keys?user={slug}` |
| `addGpgKey(data)` | `POST /rest/gpg/latest/keys?user={slug}` — `data: { text }` (ASCII-armored public key) |
| `deleteGpgKey(fingerprintOrId)` | `DELETE /rest/gpg/latest/keys/{fingerprintOrId}` |

## Webhook event parsing

`parseWebhookEvent(headers, body)` — a receiving-side utility (not a REST call) that parses an incoming Bitbucket webhook delivery into a typed, discriminated `{ event, payload }` pair. It reads the `X-Event-Key` header Bitbucket sends with every delivery (case-insensitive; falls back to the body's `eventKey` field, which is absent only on `diagnostics:ping`), then narrows `payload` to the matching type via a TS discriminated union — `switch (event) { case 'pr:opened': payload.pullRequest... }` type-checks correctly. `headers` accepts a Fetch `Headers`, a plain object (array values supported for repeated headers), or anything with `get(name)`.

No signature verification or runtime schema validation is performed — `payload` is trusted as-is, same as this client trusts JSON REST responses elsewhere. Also exported: `getWebhookEventKey(headers)` (just the header extraction), and `isWebhookEventKey(key)` (a type guard, useful to detect event keys Bitbucket adds in future versions that aren't in the table below — `parseWebhookEvent` still returns those at runtime with the raw string/body, just without static narrowing).

```typescript
import { parseWebhookEvent } from 'bitbucket-datacenter-api-client';

app.post('/webhooks/bitbucket', (req, res) => {
  const { event, payload } = parseWebhookEvent(req.headers, req.body);
  if (event === 'pr:opened') console.log(payload.pullRequest.title);
  res.sendStatus(204);
});
```

| Event key | Payload type |
| --- | --- |
| `diagnostics:ping` | `DiagnosticsPingPayload` — `{ test: true }`, no actor |
| `repo:refs_changed` | `RepoRefsChangedPayload` — `{ actor, repository, changes: WebhookRefChange[] }` |
| `repo:modified` | `RepoModifiedPayload` — `{ actor, old, new }` (both `BitbucketRepository`) |
| `repo:forked` | `RepoForkedPayload` — `{ actor, repository }` |
| `repo:comment:added` | `RepoCommentAddedPayload` — `{ actor, repository, commit, comment, commentParentId? }` |
| `repo:comment:edited` | `RepoCommentEditedPayload` — adds `previousComment` |
| `repo:comment:deleted` | `RepoCommentDeletedPayload` |
| `mirror:repo_synchronized` | `MirrorRepoSynchronizedPayload` — `{ repository }`, no actor |
| `pr:opened` | `PrOpenedPayload` — `{ actor, pullRequest }` |
| `pr:from_ref_updated` | `PrFromRefUpdatedPayload` — adds `previousFromHash` |
| `pr:modified` | `PrModifiedPayload` — adds `previousTitle?`, `previousDescription?`, `previousTarget?` |
| `pr:reviewer:approved` | `PrReviewerApprovedPayload` — `{ actor, pullRequest, participant, previousStatus }` |
| `pr:reviewer:unapproved` | `PrReviewerUnapprovedPayload` |
| `pr:reviewer:needs_work` | `PrReviewerNeedsWorkPayload` |
| `pr:merged` | `PrMergedPayload` — `{ actor, pullRequest }` |
| `pr:declined` | `PrDeclinedPayload` |
| `pr:deleted` | `PrDeletedPayload` |
| `pr:comment:added` | `PrCommentAddedPayload` — `{ actor, pullRequest, comment, commentParentId? }` |
| `pr:comment:edited` | `PrCommentEditedPayload` — adds `previousComment` |
| `pr:comment:deleted` | `PrCommentDeletedPayload` |

## Coverage

The roadmap is fully implemented: every planned method across `BitbucketClient`, `ProjectResource`, `RepositoryResource`, `PullRequestResource`, `CommitResource`, and `UserResource` is available (the only ⚠️ is `RepositoryResource.size()`, kept deliberately on an unofficial endpoint). Whole API groups deliberately out of scope (admin/ops-oriented; open an issue if you need one): system maintenance, admin authentication (IdP/SSO), global admin permissions, security (secret scanning, X.509), mirroring, search/indexing admin, SAML/CSP. See ROADMAP.md for the method-by-endpoint matrix.

## Pagination

Every list method returns `PagedResponse<T>`: `{ values, size, limit, isLastPage, start, nextPageStart? }`.

```typescript
// Manual paging
let start: number | undefined;
const all: BitbucketRepository[] = [];
do {
  const page = await bb.project('PROJ').repos({ limit: 100, start });
  all.push(...page.values);
  start = page.nextPageStart;
} while (start !== undefined);

// Auto-pagination
import { paginate } from 'bitbucket-datacenter-api-client';
for await (const repo of paginate((params) => bb.project('PROJ').repos(params), { limit: 100 })) {
  console.log(repo.slug);
}
```

## Error handling

Non-2xx responses throw `BitbucketApiError`: `{ status, statusText, message, errors: BitbucketErrorDetail[] }`. `errors` is `[]` when the response had no structured error body (Bitbucket's `{ errors: [{ context, message, exceptionName }] }` shape).

```typescript
import { BitbucketApiError } from 'bitbucket-datacenter-api-client';
try {
  await bb.project('NONEXISTENT');
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof BitbucketApiError) {
    console.log(err.status, err.statusText, err.message, err.errors);
  }
}
```

## Rate limiting

`429` responses are thrown as `BitbucketApiError` by default. Opt into retries via the `retry` constructor option; the client honours `Retry-After` (seconds or HTTP date):

```typescript
new BitbucketClient({ apiUrl, apiPath, user, token, retry: { maxRetries: 3, maxDelayMs: 30000 } });
```

## Request events

```typescript
bb.on('request', (event) => {
  // event: { url, method, startedAt, finishedAt, durationMs, statusCode?, error? }
});
```

## Key exported types

`BitbucketClient`, `BitbucketClientOptions`, `RetryOptions`, `RequestEvent`, `BitbucketClientEvents`, `AuthType`, `Security`, `BitbucketApiError`, `BitbucketErrorDetail`, `paginate`, `PagedResponse`, `PaginationParams`, `ProjectResource`, `RepositoryResource`, `PullRequestResource`, `CommitResource`, `UserResource`, `parseWebhookEvent`, `getWebhookEventKey`, `isWebhookEventKey`, `BitbucketWebhookEvent`, `WebhookEventKey`, plus one domain type module per resource (`BitbucketProject`, `BitbucketRepository`, `BitbucketPullRequest`, `BitbucketCommit`, `BitbucketUser`, `BitbucketWebhook`, `BitbucketBranch`, `BitbucketTag`, `BitbucketDiff`, `BitbucketChange`, `BitbucketAccessToken`/`BitbucketCreatedAccessToken`, `BitbucketSshKey`, `BitbucketGpgKey`, `BitbucketPullRequestSuggestion`, `MarkupPreviewResult`, `CodeSearchResult`, etc.) — see README.md's "TypeScript types" section for the full import list.
